specific_exclusions: Purely cosmetic surgical procedures without reconstructive clinical justification
Experimental or unproven clinical therapies not FDA approved
Unbundled hospital administrative and duplicate tray surcharges
Non-emergency care rendered by out-of-network providers without prior authorization

clauses.content: Emergency Services & No Surprises Act: Emergency care rendered in an acute hospital ER is covered at the in-network cost-sharing level (subject to $1,000 deductible and 20% co-insurance) regardless of the facility or physician's network affiliation.

Diagnostic Imaging (MRI / CT): Inpatient or emergency diagnostic imaging is reimbursed at allowed standard fee schedules (e.g. CPT 70553 Brain MRI cap $1,850.00). Claims exceeding regional standard by > 40% will be adjusted to benchmark.

Unbundled Billing Charges: Reimbursable services must be billed according to standard CMS National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) bundles. Separate line items for standard surgical trays, gowns, and room prep already included in primary procedure codes are disallowed.
Cosmetic and Elective Enhancements: Procedures performed solely for aesthetic improvement or non-medically necessary reasons are excluded from coverage.
